text: DSH Expert Mode（DSH agent preset）：为 DSH 提供由首席协调官调度的多领域专家团队。通过 agent preset 注入协调提示、专家委派工具和任务工作流，并按任务类别路由首轮工具与 persona。主要能力包括将复杂工作分派给领域专家、管理带依赖和恢复状态的任务、让专家通过文件消息总线交流，以及对高风险工作执行交叉评审和分阶段质量门禁。适合需要在 DSH 中组织多代理协作、处理多步骤开发或研究任务的用户。安装需要 DSH 插件环境；不需要额外 API 密钥。

DSH Expert Mode is a DSH agent preset for coordinating domain experts. It supports task delegation, dependency tracking, agent messaging, task-based routing, staged tool access, and review gates. For multi-agent work in DSH; requires no additional API key.

小问题由协调代理自己回答，只有复杂问题才委派出去。
I want DSH to route a request to a specialist agent based on its subject.
Can several agents work on dependent tasks and share progress through a task board?
I need agents to message one another directly while a coordinator handles the overall request.
DSH Expert Mode 的功能「领域专家委派」：协调官可将任务派给具备不同 persona 的专家代理，也允许简单任务由协调官直接处理。专家以可继续的子代理工具接入。
DSH Expert Mode 的功能「依赖任务看板」：用命令创建、认领、完成或失败任务，按依赖推进状态，并能在重启后恢复过期的运行中任务。
DSH Expert Mode 的功能「专家消息总线」：代理可向单个收件箱发送消息或广播给其他专家，并读取、确认和归档消息。
DSH Expert Mode 的功能「首轮任务路由」：路由器从用户请求中提取文本并分类，按任务模式选择 persona 与首轮核心工具。
DSH Expert Mode 的功能「分阶段工具披露」：按理解、规划、开发和验证阶段控制工具可见范围，并提供工具目录、帮助和阶段推进工具。
DSH Expert Mode 的功能「交叉评审与质量门禁」：配置要求高风险任务依次经历需求、实现、验证、独立审查和集成，并限制返工轮数。
DSH Expert Mode 使用前须知：插件安装器会把 preset 内容复制到用户目录 ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/expert-mode；直接从源码使用时也需将 preset 文件挂载到 DSH 的发现目录。

| ⚡ **Fault Recovery** | Auto-retry on timeout, strategy switch on failure |
| 📉 **Progressive Disclosure** | Methodology injected on-demand, 28% token savings |
| 🌐 **Bilingual** | Complete EN/ZH

dsh-expert-mode README · Option A: npm one-click (recommended) 🚀：The package is published on npm as [`dsh-expert-mode`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-expert-mode). You can install it with the DSH plugin manager or npm directly:

```bash
dsh-expert-mode README · In DSH workspace — via plugin manager：dsh plugin add dsh-expert-mode
section: In DSH workspace — via plugin manager

text:
dsh-expert-mode README · ...or install the npm package directly：npm install dsh-expert-mode
```

> ℹ️ **How agent-presets work**: this is an **agent-preset plugin**, not a Cordis service plugin. Installing the npm package pulls all files into your `node_modules` — but the preset only **activates** once its files are mounted into DSH's preset discovery directory. The preset ships a copy step (below) that makes this one command.

dsh-expert-mode README · Option B: One-command preset mount (recommended for activation)：After installing the npm package, mount the preset into DSH's preset discovery directory:

```bash
section: Option B: One-command preset mount (recommended for activation)

text:
dsh-expert-mode README · 2. Mount the preset into DSH's agent-presets directory：mkdir -p ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/expert-mode
cp -r node_modules/dsh-expert-mode/agent.cordis.yml \
      node_modules/dsh-expert-mode/preset.yml \
      node_modules/dsh-expert-mode/cordis.patch.yml \
      ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/expert-mode/
section: 2. Mount the preset into DSH's agent-presets directory

text:
dsh-expert-mode README · 3. Restart DSH web, then select "专家模式" in the workspace preset selector：dsh web
```

> **Note**: `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/` is DSH's preset discovery directory. Each subdirectory = one preset. The preset name comes from `preset.yml`'s `name` field.

dsh-expert-mode README · Optional: Cross-session memory (recommended)：The expert-mode preset itself does **not** register the cross-session memory service — it is a HOST-PLANE plugin, and registering it inside a preset conflicts with the host composition (causing preset mount failure). To enable cross-session memory, install [dsh-memory-connect](https://github.com/Asher-2000/dsh-memory-connect) separately into the **host composition**:

```bash

dsh-expert-mode README · 1. Clone the memory plugin：git clone https://github.com/Asher-2000/dsh-memory-connect.git
cd dsh-memory-connect
npm install github:Asher-2000/dsh-memory-connect#v0.4.0  # or place it into the dsh dependency tree manually

dsh-expert-mode README · 3. Restart DSH web：dsh web
```

> ⚠️ **Important**: **Do NOT** add `@deepseek-ai/dsh-memory-connect` into this preset's `agent.cordis.yml`. It is a HOST-PLANE plugin (injects `sessions` + `systemPrompt`); registering it inside the preset throws `service has been registered at <cross-session-memory>`, which makes the expert-mode preset fail to mount and the UI fall back to the default preset. This preset ships with an explanatory comment about it.

dsh-expert-mode README · 💬 Inter-Expert Communication Bus (v0.8.0)：**Communication Modes**:
| Mode | How | Use case |
|------|-----|----------|
| **A. Relay** | Expert A sends result → Expert B reads | Sequential collaboration |
| **B. Parallel** | Experts send results to coordinator → read --all | Independent collection |
| **C. Broadcast** | One message → all mailboxes | Global state changes |
| **D. Review** | Experts send "agree/partial/disagree + reason" | Cross review |
| **E. P2P** | Expert spawns subagent for direct Q&A | Synchronous clarification |
